description:
Want your skin to glow and be hydrated all winter? 🤩

Our 5% Niacinamide Body Wash is 100% safe with 0 Parabens & 0 Silicones. It helps to:

🌟 Protect from pollution:  Antioxidant properties of Niacinamide neutralizes free radicals. This prevents oxidtive stress and damage to the skin 

🌟 Provide intense hydration: Niacinamide pulls moisture from the environment keeping skin soft and supple

🌟 Even skin:  Niacinamide and Aloe Vera help battle hyperpigmentation & skin discoloration

🌟Deep cleanse skin: Deep cleanses pores by reducing sebum production and removing impurities

✅ Use daily for at least 3 months for best results🗓️

Step 1: On wet skin, take some body wash in your palms or on a loofah.
Step 2: Massage the body wash into skin using gentle, circular motions.
Step 3: Once done, rinse with lukewarm/cold water.

faqs.question: Can I use niacinamide body wash every day?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using this body wash for all skin types once a day, every day.

faqs.question: Is niacinamide good for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types.

faqs.question: Can I use this twice a day?
faqs.answer: We recommend consulting your expert to verify the same.

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend checking with your expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

faqs.question: What does Niacinamide do for skin?
faqs.answer: Niacinamide helps repair the protective layer of the skin. It promotes the production of ceramides and elastin. Over time it helps reduce melanin transfer to outer layer of skin, which helps fade marks.
